content:
Laredo police are reporting a traffic accident at Highway 83 and Cross Street in South Laredo at about 7:00 p.m. Monday, November 9, according to 24/7 Laredo.

The accident happened along the northbound lanes, causing traffic congestion and delays.

Officers are on scene directing traffic. It remains unknown whether anyone was injured.

Drivers are advised to avoid the intersection if possible, take alternate routes, and expect delays.

Sources: 24/7 Laredo, November 9, 2026.

excerpt: A traffic accident at Highway 83 and Cross Street in South Laredo on Monday evening backed up northbound traffic, with officers on scene directing traffic. It is unknown whether anyone was injured.
title: Traffic accident on Highway 83 and Cross Street in South Laredo backs up northbound traffic
